en: Color panoramic view over a valley city surrounded by steep green mountains. In the foreground are vineyards, orchards, scattered houses with red-tiled roofs, and a large roundabout where several highways converge. A distinctive, almost oval, tree‑covered hill with exposed rock on its sides stands near the center-right, with the dense urban area stretching behind it along a river at the foot of the mountains. The scene is photographed on a clear day with blue sky and cumulus clouds. No visible printed text appears on the front.
